# Smoke Veil

A second-level spell with concentration and an area: the fixture with
no higher-level line. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: 5e_2024
  card-type: spell
data:
  name: Smoke Veil
  level: 2
  school: Conjuration
  classes: [Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard]
  casting-time: Action
  range: 90 feet
  components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot)
  duration: 10 minutes
  concentration: true
  description: |
    Thick, ash-grey smoke billows out in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centred on a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured, and it spreads around corners.

    A wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses the smoke after 1 minute; a strong wind disperses it at once.
```
